name: UGC / Social Realism
visual_style: Authentic smartphone-style footage with realistic skin, informal home or outdoor setting and modest imperfections.
camera: Handheld phone perspective at eye level with subtle natural shake.
lighting: Window light or believable everyday practical lighting.
motion: Casual real-time gestures and natural conversation-like movement.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
